Cave - meeting place


Setting

This cave meeting exposes the Faceless Brother’s identity. Erfar tells Zak about his past on Suslanger, his meteorite scheme and the ambush he has arranged. It closes the village conspiracy’s thread far from the village itself. [1, 2, 3]

Brother Faceless and the return to Gipath

Khatul asks Brother Faceless to help Zak reach the guarded portal. Faceless arranges a cave meeting and explains the keys and stone controls. He then reveals himself as Erfar: born on Suslanger, he went to Gipath seeking the meteorite and manipulated the villagers into searching for it. His earlier plots were attempts to remove Zak, who disrupted that scheme. The reunion is another trap, with guards waiting outside the cave. Zak survives the confrontation and forces a route through the portal’s defences. Activating its two controls finally returns him to Tka-Rik with the amulet fragments. [4, 5, 2, 3, 6]
